name: 11576 · Roslyn, NY
findings: ZIP 11576 (Roslyn) has 92 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11576 (Roslyn) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 11576 (Roslyn) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).
